::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This is the **reference**: the same 12 cases as [`d-panzoom-selective`](d-panzoom-selective.html),
rendered with Quarto's built-in lightbox only. The panzoom filter is not loaded
and no image carries a panzoom marker. Every block image gets the lightbox via
`lightbox: match: auto`, with `effect: fade`, `desc-position: right`,
`loop: true` and `css-class: my-lb` set to exercise those options.

Compare each case with the same numbered case in [`d-panzoom-selective`](d-panzoom-selective.html).
:::

## 5. R subfigures (fig-subcap, layout-ncol) {#c5}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two R subfigures."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. R chunks with lightbox cell options (group + description) {#c6}

This chunk sets a lightbox group and description.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Simple demo R plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

So does this one, in the same group.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Plot about cars data
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Multi-plot cell, list-valued options {#c7}

```{r}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - Caption for first plot
#|   - Caption for second plot
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. lightbox: false on a chunk {#c8}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: mtcars, lightbox false
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```
